# samsungcloudplatformv2_sqlserver_engine_version (Data Source)

List of Engine Versions.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `eos_included` (Boolean) Whether to include end-of-service versions
  - example: false
- `id` (String) Engine version ID to filter by
  - example: YOUR RESOURCE'S ID
- `product_image_type` (String) Product image type. Omit to return every image type.
  - example: Microsoft SQL Server Enterprise / Microsoft SQL Server Standard

### Read-Only

- `contents` (Attributes List) A detail of Engine Version. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--contents))

<a id="nestedatt--contents"></a>
### Nested Schema for `contents`

Required:

- `end_of_service` (Boolean) End of Service
  - example: false
- `id` (String) Engine version ID
  - example: YOUR RESOURCE'S ID
- `name` (String) Engine version name
  - example: Microsoft SQL Server 2022 Standard ENG-KB5065865-x64
- `os_type` (String) OS type
  - example: WINDOWS
- `product_image_type` (String) Product image type
  - example: Microsoft SQL Server Standard
- `software_version` (String) Software version
  - example: 2022 Standard ENG-KB5065865

Optional:

- `major_version` (String) Software major version
  - example: 2022 Standard ENG
- `os_version` (String) OS version
  - example: 2019 Std.
